# ADR-0007 — Synthetic scenarios with a predeclared answer key

**Decision:** The demonstration uses two invented scenarios, generated by [`tools/generate_synthetic.py`](../../tools/generate_synthetic.py). The expected findings were written before any agent ran; their SHA-256 hash was committed before the runs and the file itself after.

**Why:** Real test results belong to employers and customers and cannot be published. Synthetic data with a written answer key lets anyone check whether the team found what was there and avoided the traps.

**Limits:** The scenarios were designed by the same person who wrote the agent checklists, so they exercise patterns the checklists know about. This shows the method working on cases it was built for, not on unseen real-world data.

**Revisit when:** authorised, anonymised real results are available for a held-out evaluation.
